get.description: Today's per-model request counts with their caps, per-backend totals with caps and remaining, and grades awaiting retry.
Server-sent events: `event: job` with a Job JSON payload, first a snapshot then every change.
Run all preflight checks (first run + Settings screen).

post.description: Start the job behind a check's `fix_action` (e.g. build the toolchain image).
No answer = ask the first question; otherwise submit the answer and get the next question (or the finished goals).
Heavy LLM call: 2-4 next-node options from goals, scores and history; stored for POST /build.
Build the chosen option as a background `build_challenge` job (progress via /api/jobs/stream).

get.description: Build record: attempts, agent usage, tool calls, gate results (no answer-key content).

post.description: Lock the prelab answers (immutable) and unlock the lab.
Run the node's `run` commands in the workspace as a job; output streams to the job log.
Heavy call with _hidden/ access; marks the explained subskills assist_reveal.
Begin (or resume, switching mode) the oral exam; returns the view with the first question.
Text fallback: one typed answer -> the examiner's next utterance.
Push-to-talk down: the backend starts recording the microphone.
Push-to-talk up: stop, transcribe, get the examiner's reply (and its audio) in one request.
The exam is complete: grade it and move to the Debrief.

get.description: Per-domain tier and mastery of the ACTIVE track, from events.jsonl (the cache's scores table).

post.description: Create a track and make it the active one; onboarding (§9) then runs for it.

delete.description: Permanently delete everything in the trash. Needs {"confirm": "PURGE"}.
Typed-name confirmation; the track goes to the trash and can be restored until the trash is purged.

post.description: Move the track's nodes, events and misconceptions to the trash (goals kept unless keep_goals=false); onboarding re-runs.
Start the Builder/checker container; the learner container starts when a learner tool needs it (it needs a node).
Start a GUI tool on the learner container's VNC display (it mounts only `node`'s workspace/) and open noVNC in the system browser.
JupyterLab in the learner container, rooted at `node`'s workspace/ (the only directory it can see).

Builder/dev tool (the UI does not call it): run a sim as a job in the Builder container, which also sees `_hidden/`.
Path rules as for the MCP tools, pinned to `node`. The learner's Run simulation is the lifecycle `run_commands`, in the learner container.

ContainerStatus.title: ContainerStatus
ContainerStatus.description: The Builder/checker container (mounts all of data/tracks) and the learner container (one node's workspace/).
